takeaways.title: Your rate sits below the adjusted rate
takeaways.body: Example: at 2.9% of a projected £1.74m you are just under the 3.0% market-adjusted rate, leaving a margin for a poor first decade.

takeaways.title: Shares are expensive today
takeaways.body: Example: CAPE near 39 has historically meant lower returns for the next 10 years; the worst start months failed above 3.5%.

takeaways.title: Use the personal allowance from 57
takeaways.body: Example: drawing about £12,570 a year from the SIPP before the state pension starts keeps that income tax-free.

takeaways.title: Keep two years of spending in cash
takeaways.body: Example: £100k in cash would cover withdrawals through a downturn without selling shares low.
